Marta: Quick sync — got a batch of product feedback from the Helix pilot this morning. Main themes: opaque per-route cost, onboarding docs for Dedicated, and unexpected rate-limiting during burst traffic.
Ravi: Can you paste the exact asks + severity? We should triage for Q2.
Marta: Sure — pulled verbatim from notes: 
- 'Need per-route spend breakdown in Console (granular to model + route) — blocker for finance sign-off'
- 'A step-by-step Dedicated onboarding checklist (networking + KMS examples) — slows rollout'
- 'Burst throttles with 429s during warm-up; need clearer retry guidance or smoother ramp'
Jess: +1 on spend breakdown, we've had 2 renewal conversations stalled by this.
Tom: For throttles — do we have logs that show prefix pattern? If it's warm cache vs cold we can propose prefix-caching knob.
Marta: CS Bot just posted the CSV summary and NPS snippets. Paste below: 
```
customer,priority,quote
Helix,high,"can't see per-route cost — finance won't sign"
Nimble,medium,"docs assume hosted; dedicated network steps unclear"
Paragon,high,"429s when we do bulk uploads — no guidance in docs"
```
Ravi: Proposed triage: 1) Console per-route cost spike card (product), 2) Dedicated onboarding playbook (docs + solutions), 3) Throttle diagnostics + retry guidance (runtime). Which should we escalate to PL?
Jess: Escalate 1 & 3 to PL this week. 2 can be Solutions + Docs to start templates.
Tom: I'll pull throttles logs and surface any model-specific patterns by EOD. If it's cache-warm-up we can recommend a staged ramp or increase burst capacity config.
Marta: Can whoever owns Console cost UX do a quick mock? @Ravi maybe you or product can own the ticket.
Ravi: I'll own the Console ticket. Draft will include: UI mock, API schema for per-route breakdown, and an ETA for a beta release.
CS Bot: New CS signal saved: tag=onboarding,cost,throttle -- 3 customers impacted, avg severity=high :eyes:
Jess: I'll collect renewal dates for these accounts and update the risk tracker.
Marta: Thanks — next step: Ravi to create the product ticket (#PRD-xxxxx), Tom to attach diagnostics, Jess to update renewals. Check-in on Friday. :thumbsup:
Ravi: Created PRD-2712-per-route-cost and added initial mock. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/PRD-2712
Tom: Uploaded debug traces: s3://internal/trace-2712349999.zip
Marta: Copy that. We'll use the Helix quotes for prioritization in the backlog groom.
Jess: Noted — I'll flag these to Sales for renewal outreach with an interim workaround (exported usage CSV).
Marta: Perfect. If anyone gets additional quotes or severity changes, drop them here and CS Bot will append to the thread.
